body:
- pick up mlx-swift 0.32.3
- massive improves in draft models, KVCache handling, tool handling
- add MLXFoundationModels and MLXGuidedGeneration
- bug fixes

## What's Changed
* Set indentConditionalCompilationBlocks to false in .swift-format by @ctymoszek in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/385
* CI: fix mac_build_and_test for mlx-swift >= 0.31.5 (skip package plugin validation) + swift-format 603 conformance by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/404
* ci: pin swift-format version so lint doesn't drift across PRs by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/386
* Gemma 3: chunked prompt prefill, skip lm_head on prompt positions by @beshkenadze in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/346
* Fix Gemma 4 VLM load: KV-shared layers must not declare k_proj/v_proj by @fdagostino in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/390
* add note on swift-format version and fill out configuration by @davidkoski in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/416
* ChatSession: cancel the generation task when the consumer goes away by @fdagostino in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/413
* Qwen3 embedder: honor attentionMask instead of silently ignoring it by @spokvulcan in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/418
* Qwen3VL: apply the sRGB tone curve in the image preprocess path by @spokvulcan in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/411
* Convert Gemma tool parameters by schema type by @atdrendel in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/388
* Fix prefill LMOutput.State being dropped on TokenIterator's .logits path by @NivDvir in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/419
* Fix Qwen3.5 VLM garbage output: gate the RMSNorm weight shift in sanitize by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/403
* fix: Honor safetensors index when loading weights by @Zrxrxrx in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/408
* Qwen3.5/3.6: windowed prefill + state-threaded warm continuation (fixes multi-turn M-RoPE drift) by @spokvulcan in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/399
* Make DeepseekV3Model.init public by @magicnight in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/422
* Make MLXLLM compilable on Linux by @gmondada in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/321
* Fix tool round-trip: record assistant tool_calls message before tool results by @jacobwillemsma in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/409
* Add cooperative cancellation check to the prompt prefill loop by @sunshinfight in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/423
* Fix cancellation submission race by @SpiraMira in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/389
* Add MLXFoundationModels: an MLX-backed FoundationModels LanguageModel by @ctymoszek in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/334
* Update project name in CONTRIBUTING.md by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/427
* Decode PoolingConfiguration with optional pooling_mode flags by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/376
* Qwen3VL: default per-image resolution to a 1,280 vision-token budget by @spokvulcan in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/398
* Fix silent state truncation for non-multiple-of-32 GDN key dim by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/381
* Document model compatibility requirements by @RNT56 in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/303
* Fix MLXVLM Gemma4 loader to honor num_kv_shared_layers (E-series targets) by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/384
* Document -skipPackagePluginValidation for local test runs by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/430
* Fix Python finfo.min port in quantized attention masking by @ronaldmannak in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/369
* Implement Gemma 4 E-series MTP centroid embedder (use_ordered_embeddings) by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/383
* Update link to CONTRIBUTING document in PR template by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/428
* Gemma 4: aspect-preserving image resize with per-image dynamic token counts; fix multi-image requests by @prbme in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/405
* Track the current SDK's SamplingMode.Kind case names by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/431
* update tag on swift-format -- I had it wrong by @davidkoski in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/421
* Fix FoundationModels API drift and the integration tests that no longer compiled by @thechriswebb in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/438
* Prepare tool-calling input through the model's processor (fixes #433) by @jyauxi in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/435
* Make BaseKVCache.ropeOffset overridable by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/437
* fix(MLXFoundationModels): stop respond() crashing when emitting usage on the FM-27 SDK by @thechriswebb in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/439
* Silence Metal compiler warning noise in integration test runs by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/440
* add TurboQuant KV cache compression by @TheTom in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/232
* Expose minimal Gemma3 surface for frozen-text-encoder use by @xocialize in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/387
* Load EOS token IDs from nested text configs by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/449
* Optimize Qwen3.5 interleaved M-RoPE by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/442
* MLXLLM Gemma4Text: add MoE block (router + experts) for the text path by @neuromechanist in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/364
* Fix MTP integration test skip semantics; auto-download 31B checkpoint pair by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/445
* Enable MTP speculative decoding for Gemma 4 12B (gemma4_unified target + gemma4_unified_assistant drafter) by @fdagostino in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/415
* Hoist tool-schema $defs to the tool-calling envelope root (fixes #432) by @jyauxi in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/434
* Qwen3VL vision: stop using a huge amount of memory to process images. by @kklimuk in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/455
* Add regression coverage for mixed-precision (per-layer) quantized checkpoint loading by @fdagostino in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/395
* DeepSeek-V3: populate kvHeads and update the KV cache once per attention call by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/457
* Support multi-round tool calling in MLXFoundationModels by @thechriswebb in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/456
* Add DeepSeek-V2 model by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/379
* Add Hunyuan dense V1 (hunyuan_v1_dense): Hunyuan-MT-7B and Hy-MT2-7B by @beshkenadze in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/347
* Add GitHub workflow for IntegrationTesting tests by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/458
* Add end-to-end video input to the base Gemma 4 (gemma4) VLM by @fdagostino in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/391
* Integration tests: build on both macOS 26 and 27 SDKs by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/464
* Add routing-correctness tests for GLM4MOE / GLM4MOELite MoE gates by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/463
* Fix guided generation dropping required properties (streaming detokenizer) by @thechriswebb in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/465
* Integration tests CI: run on Xcode 26 only by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/477
* Gate remaining FoundationModels integration tests behind the 27 SDK by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/478
* Integration tests: scope down heavy suites, fix flakes and memory pressure by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/480
* Add Nanbeige4.2 (looped transformer) model support by @spokvulcan in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/460
* Qwen3.5/3.6: run the decode step through compiled traces by @spokvulcan in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/467
* Qwen3.5/3.6 MoE: fused router top-k kernel for decode (bit-identical, CI-pinned) by @spokvulcan in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/469
* Fix Gemma 3n Boolean attention masks by @codesworth in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/479
* Fix lfm2 toolcall parser and glm4 gate GLM-4-0414 by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/481
* Qwen3.5/3.6: fold the GDN decode conv into the compiled step by @spokvulcan in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/468
* Fix structured ChatSession continuations by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/472
* Let models declare chat conventions via ChatConventionsProviding by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/482
* Qwen2.5-VL / Qwen2-VL: windowed prefill + state-threaded warm continuation (wires #420) by @NivDvir in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/448
* Fix remaining Linux build breaks in MLXLMCommon and MLXGuidedGeneration by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/483
* Fix gated delta recurrence precision by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/488
* Fix TF32 test-oracle flakiness in the Gemma4 chunk-invariance tests by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/485
* Add support for Qwen3-VL-MoE models by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/322
* Migrate all models to ChatConventionsProviding; delete the infer chains by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/502
* Add custom LogitProcessor injection to GenerateParameters / ChatSession by @xocialize in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/401
* Run Integration Tests nightly and report failures on a tracking issue by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/513
* Stand down from MTP speculation before the sliding cache wraps by @angelsbrood in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/506
* Add typed KV cache configuration and runtime reporting by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/453
* Add parser for GPT-OSS Harmony tool call format by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/146
* Prefill: balanced chunking behind a new PrefillParameters (~9% at 32K) by @spokvulcan in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/470
* Olmo3: fix newCache signature so the sliding-window cache is actually used by @GoodOlClint in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/462
* Prompt cache: persist model state, wire Qwen3-VL and GLM-OCR restoration, and fail closed by @kklimuk in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/475
* Add single-dispatch TurboFlash for short contexts by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/520
* Update Package.swift by @ActuallyTaylor in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/519
* Fix tied quantized Qwen3 MoE head sanitization by @JamesPriceZV in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/490
* Speculate past the sliding window in MTP by @angelsbrood in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/516
* Remove the untyped staged-cache fallback by @angelsbrood in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/526
* Add Muse-Glimmer, a 30B agentic multimodal model, with ATEM tool calling by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/523

* Add protocol-aware thinking budget enforcement by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/521
* Add Qwen3.5 MTP speculative decoding by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/351
* Add Qwen 3.5 JSON tool-call fallback by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/529
* bump mlx-swift to 0.31.6 -- .4 was missing new API that the current code calls by @davidkoski in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/484
* Expose Gemma 4 encoder surface at @_spi(GemmaEncoder) by @xocialize in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/530
* Enforce copy semantics on LogitProcessor for speculative decoding (#508) by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/533
* Fix tied word embedding weight sanitization by @aleroot in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/532
* Add TranslateGemma support (Gemma 3 translation template) by @beshkenadze in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/348

* Add an Xcode 27 compile check and handle Generation.rejectedToolCall by @CharlieTLe in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm/pull/538
